propositions: The Git version floor gate step reads .github/git-version-floor.txt from the patchset tree but the workflow definition comes from main, causing hard failure on changes branched before the file was added
Every open change created before commit c433663721 fails Verified lane with missing floor file error regardless of whether the change touches git-version-related code

The gate violates the documented Definition-vs-tree skew guard convention (ticket ee2a) which requires gate steps reading repo artifacts to skip gracefully when the artifact is absent from the checked-out tree

The fix applies the established if-present guard pattern: absent floor file skips with explanatory log naming the real remedy (rebase/post-merge re-enforcement), while present floor file enforces the version floor unchanged
